cd /tmp/t && cat > checkbig.py <<'PY'
import socket, subprocess, random, sys
# brute-force check on a sample of queries using the original FIB
fib = []
for line in open('/tmp/t/big.fib'):
    a, l, h = line.split()
    l = int(l); h = int(h)
    b = socket.inet_pton(socket.AF_INET6, a)
    k = int.from_bytes(b[:8],'big')
    if l == 0:
        k = 0; end = 1<<64
    else:
        k &= (~0) << (64-l); end = k + (1<<(64-l))
    fib.append((k,end,l,h))
random.seed(7)
qs = []
with open('/tmp/t/big.trace') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()
for i in random.sample(range(len(lines)), 300):
    qs.append(lines[i].strip())
r = subprocess.run(['/work/submit/planb64','lookup','/tmp/t/big.idx','/tmp/t/big.trace','scalar'],capture_output=True,text=True)
out = r.stdout.split('\n')
# recompute expectations for sampled indices
idxs = random.sample(range(len(lines)), 300)
exp = []
for i in idxs:
    b = socket.inet_pton(socket.AF_INET6, qs[idxs.index(i)])
    key = int.from_bytes(b[:8],'big')
    best=None
    for k,e,l,h in fib:
        if k <= key < e:
            if best is None or l > best[0]: best=(l,h)
    exp.append("-1 -1" if best is None else "%d %d"%(best[1],best[0]))
got = [out[i] for i in idxs]
if got != exp:
    for i,(g,e) in enumerate(zip(got,exp)):
        if g!=e: print("MISMATCH at", idxs[i], g, e); break
    sys.exit(1)
print("big sample OK")
